gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-anek-bangla: Woodgod has a vintage, commanding swagger, with a wide channel cut into every bowl. Anek Bangla follows in a friendly sans-serif, its s curves barely curled in, which gives the display heading room to be big and brief.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-anek-devanagari: Anek Devanagari reads modern and unfussy, a plain sans with distinctly open mouths and a tall middle zone. And Woodgod, vintage and commanding, supplies the one thing it lacks: a loud personality up top.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-anek-gujarati: Anek Gujarati reads clean and approachable, its lowercase rivaling the capitals and its c gaping wide. Woodgod stays vintage and commanding above it, and a long page below would feel friendly rather than heavy.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Commanding is how Woodgod looks, vintage and weighty, with tall lowercase nearly touching its capitals. Anek Gurmukhi sits beneath as a plain sans, its big open counters and generous curves giving the heading some breathing space.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-anek-kannada: Woodblock punch, then a modern hush. Anek Kannada is a plain sans with a high x-height and terminals that stop far from the stem, so a long stretch of it reads contemporary and spacious.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-anek-latin: Vintage muscle up top, tall lowercase nearly reaching Woodgod's capitals. And Anek Latin, a sans with its letters held open, can take a modest size, since its own tall lowercase carries the text.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-anek-malayalam: Anek Malayalam is a clean, contemporary sans-serif with minimal gap between x-height and caps, and curves that never touch. Woodgod earns its keep big and short.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-anek-odia: Anek Odia reads clean and contemporary, its rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook. And Woodgod's strongest quality is that vintage, commanding voice, which makes the sans below feel like a quiet reply.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-anek-tamil: Big round bowls, vintage swagger. Anek Tamil, a plain sans with half-unwrapped c and s shapes, would read modern and open across a long passage beneath Woodgod's commanding heading.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu reads clean and approachable, with a rhythm led by wide, tall bowls that stay unsealed. Woodgod, vintage and commanding, sits above and gives that friendly sans a heading with real presence.
